summary_en: Tender offer by BCPE Neon Cayman, L.P. to acquire baudroie (4413) at ¥2,970/share, minimum 3,135,200 shares. Warrants (series 2–7) at ¥1 each. Period: Aug 19 – Oct 5, 2026 (31 business days). Board recommends acceptance; intended to make company wholly owned and delist from TSE Prime. Three incumbent executives (Shigekane Tominaga, Kazuya Fujii, Yoshiaki Hodoshima) committed to remain post-completion.
title_en: Notice regarding implementation of MBO and recommendation to tender
translation_en_brief: On 18 August 2026, the board of baudroie, inc. (TSE Prime: 4413) approved and recommended to shareholders a management buyout by BCPE Neon Cayman, L.P., a Cayman Islands limited partnership sponsored by Bain Capital. The tender offer runs from 19 August to 5 October 2026 (31 business days) and targets the acquisition of all ordinary shares at ¥2,970 per share, with a minimum purchase threshold of 3,135,200 shares. Seven series of warrants (2nd through 7th) will be tendered at ¥1 each. Three incumbent executives—Shigekane Tominaga (representative director and largest shareholder as of 28 February 2026), Kazuya Fujii (director and second-largest shareholder), and Yoshiaki Hodoshima (director and fifth-largest shareholder)—have committed to participate in the MBO and continue managing the company post-closing. The transaction is intended to make baudroie a wholly owned subsidiary and result in delisting from the TSE Prime Market. The board found no material capital, personnel, or transaction relationships between the offeror and the company or its officers. Bain Capital Japan Middle Market Fund II, L.P. is the ultimate sponsor.
